name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A region docked to a viewport edge (end, start, bottom): Base UI Dialog behaviour, unfolds from its edge, cut on the inner corner.
whenToUse: Use it for the detail of one thing opened from a list, docked to an edge at full height. For a short blocking task use Dialog; for a non-blocking side panel use Inspector.

parts.name: SheetPopup
parts.description: The sheet: Base UI's Portal, Backdrop and Popup in one part, docked to a viewport edge. It carries the configuration (cut, density, motion, theme, dir) of the place it is written, not of <body>.

props.name: side
props.description: end: the inline-end edge (mirrors in RTL) · start · bottom.

props.name: size
props.description: Width (end/start) or height (bottom) in px or any CSS length.
